symptom: partner distribution becomes 1.0/0/0/0/0 early and stays
likely cause: one partner always gives max regret, adversary exploits
normal?: possibly normal if one partner is genuinely hardest for all focals
fix: check regret matrix, if one column dominates then collapse is correct

mode: regret stays high and never decreases
symptom: per-step regret flat or increasing after many outer steps
likely cause: focal agent not learning from the partner selection signal
fix: check focal agent inner-loop training is actually updating params

likely cause: focal agent already at best response for all partners, or antagonist value wrong
normal?: suspicious, only expected if focal = optimal for all 5 partners
fix: verify antagonist value computation, check cross-play matrix

mode: all partners get equal weight forever
likely cause: adversary learning rate too low, or all partners give similar regret
normal?: normal if regret is genuinely flat across partners
fix: check regret variance across partners, increase adv lr if near-zero

mode: focal agent performance degrades during UED
symptom: focal return drops below pre-UED level
likely cause: adversary pushing into catastrophically hard partners, focal forgets easy ones
normal?: can happen early, not normal at convergence
fix: add evaluation against held-out partner set, check for catastrophic forgetting

likely cause: agent_0 and agent_1 have different roles (emergent specialization), or eval noise
normal?: normal in overcooked (roles matter), but magnitude should be checked
fix: increase eval rollouts to reduce noise, report standard errors
